action_space.contract_action: BUY one exact eligible SPXW 0DTE call or put contract

stage_1_quality_screen.anchor_interpretation: candidate bottom-tail exclusion level; 0.25 is the literal worst-quartile anchor and adjacent levels test a deliberately loose neighborhood
stage_1_quality_screen.threshold_rule: For every component and unit, compute the market-phase training-calibration quantile at alpha when higher is favorable and at 1-alpha when lower is favorable. A contract passes only if every component and both units of every paired component pass.
stage_1_quality_screen.missing_component_rule: fail the contract; missing required state cannot be converted to a favorable value

stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.input_contracts: only contracts passing stage_1 and the physical/safety action mask
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.available_horizon_rule: use every registered horizon whose target_valid and forecast_valid masks are true; a contract with no valid registered horizon fails
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.positive_after_fee_rule: the equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE must be strictly greater than zero in both dollars and return, and the equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 profit area must be strictly greater than zero in both dollar-minutes and return-minutes
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.phase_percentile_rule: Map each conservative component to its favorable empirical percentile using only the frozen market-phase calibration distribution. Percentiles use linear interpolation and lie in [0,1].

dollar_percent_arbitration.across_horizons: arithmetic mean over valid registered horizons
dollar_percent_arbitration.reason: a contract must be defensible in both cash outcome and return on premium; neither an expensive dollar winner nor a cheap percentage winner can dominate on one axis alone

stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.tertiary_rank_score: equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE return
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.quaternary_rank_score: equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE dollars

uncertainty_wait.model_gap_error: On chronological training-only OOF predictions, compute absolute error between predicted and realized top-versus-runner-up balanced-upside score gaps. The conformal model gap is the finite-sample 0.90 split-conformal quantile.
uncertainty_wait.source_transfer_error: Candidate-specific p95 absolute top-versus-runner-up score-gap drift from the accepted historical/IBKR transfer audit; zero is permitted only when the score is proved bit-identical. Missing required transfer evidence blocks live activation but not design-stage historical research.
uncertainty_wait.runner_up: the highest-ranked different eligible contract; if none exists, WAIT is the runner-up
rules: WAIT unless selected primary_rank_score minus runner_up primary_rank_score is strictly greater than wait_margin
WAIT unless both conservative MFE means exceed their own 0.90 conformal absolute-error margins in dollars and return
equality with any margin produces WAIT

wait_conditions: no contract survives the physical and safety action mask
required market, contract, mask, phase, account, forecast, or calibration state is missing
no contract clears every quality guardrail
no surviving contract has conservative upside strictly above zero after fees on both dollar and return axes
top score is inside the calibrated model/source uncertainty margin versus runner-up or WAIT
action-conditioned confidence gate is not activated where confidence controls behavior
